about: Must-have promo moments picked by reading the scripts (one editor's judgement). A promo 'finds' a moment if a segment covers >= 50% of the moment's window. Hook/cliff seconds are episode time.

moments.what: Juliana reaches the altar: 'Why are you holding her hand?' / 'Because he is marrying me.' ... 'never going to marry you.'
Family rejects her: 'You have embarrassed this family' ... 'the true jewel of the county' (episode-end sting)
'Guards! Remove her!' - she is dragged - the bearded stranger drops a guard: 'Then don't touch her again.'
The stranger kneels with a ring: 'Lady Juliana... accept my hand.' (episode-end cliff)
Stepmother flings her late mother's ledger into the mud; husband: 'Choose your next words carefully.'
'You planted it!' - Clarissa's ultimatum: crawl into frozen thorns barehanded or 'your husband hangs from the gallows'
'Then let her suffer.' - riding-crop strike - 'Perhaps when your hands are black enough...'
Duchess: 'My lost son wore that exact ring!' 'What is your husband's name?' - doors burst open
'It is an antidote.' 'To what?' 'Poison.' - framed: 'She admits...' - 'Take her.'
Chained Juliana paraded at the villains' wedding - the cathedral doors explode
Identity reveal: 'It's you.' 'You're the Duke?' 'Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke.'
'...my lawful wife and the Duchess' - High Priest bursts in: 'You are not his lawful wife.'
